title: Inbox WhatsApp Worker searches the whole chat and reads voice-note transcripts
text: The WhatsApp Worker in the Inbox used to see only the newest 30 messages of a chat, so it could say a price was never mentioned when it had been said earlier. It now searches the whole open chat (up to 5,000 messages) by words, sender and dates, including voice-note transcripts and quoted replies, and says how much it covered. Times it shows follow your own clock, so they match your screen.
points: Voice notes in WhatsApp chats can now be played and their transcript read by everyone who can use the Inbox, not only staff. Photos, videos and documents stay staff-only.
The Worker gives the result first, without describing where it looked.
Messages hidden from your own screen stay hidden from the Worker too.
